chunks: And ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh asked him:
About making up the fasts of the month of Ramadan in Dhū al-Ḥijjah and interrupting it, he said: “Make it up in Dhū al-Ḥijjah and interrupt it if you wish.”

key_terms.ذِي الْحِجَّةِ: the month of Dhū al-Ḥijjah as the time in which the make-up fast is performed
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan whose missed fasts are being made up
key_terms.قَضَاءِ: making up an obligation missed earlier
key_terms.قَطْعِهِ: interrupting or breaking the fast before completion

ai.seo_question: Can missed Ramadan fasts be made up in Dhū al-Ḥijjah, and may they be interrupted?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about making up missed sawm of Ramadan during Dhū al-Ḥijjah. It indicates that one may perform the make-up fast in that month and may interrupt it if one wishes.
